text_block_list.text:
She wanted to end her Twinkle Series career with the Nikkei Sho.
It was a few weeks before the Nikkei Sho when she first brought it up—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
Even though you've always supported me, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, I... I don't have the right
to stand on the turf anymore.
choice_data_list: Why so suddenly... say something like that...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Watching Orfe-san at the Arima Kinen...
made me realize that she's the true star of the show.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: From the bottom of my heart, I thought that was the real deal... and that there was no way I could do it...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I can't push myself anymore.
I don't even have the right to try.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So――even though you've been working so hard for me,
I'm truly, truly sorry.
……Please let the next one be my last.

I was at a loss for words.
To feel that way while being at this academy must be
painful. It's not hard to imagine. And besides—

I cursed my decision during summer camp.
She needed help, after all.
I made assumptions on my own and let you say something like this without offering any help...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
N-No, wait! I was the one hiding it!
Trainer didn't do anything wrong...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who should be apologizing.
I let myself get overwhelmed and ended up like this...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so, so sorry.

...After that, I tried to persuade her,
but Win Variation's resolve remained firm.
choice_data_list: (If I'm being honest, I want to ask her to stay)

text_block_list.text:
However, I don't have the right
to say something like that right now.

At the very least, I will continue to properly support her through the Nikkei Sho.
With that resolve in my heart, days went by—
The day of the Nikkei Sho.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: This is the last one.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Why? Because it's the end!
I'll pour everything I have into this race...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Thank you so much... for everything up until today!

I simply watch her walk out slowly.
Cheers erupt from the turf,
and the fanfare blares out.
The Nikkei Sho is about to start.
